name: github-dev-orchestrator
description: Dream: a compact, safe GitHub issue-to-PR workflow.

interface.longDescription: A concise GitHub issue-to-PR development orchestrator using Ponytail, Grill Me, safe approvals and CI.
defaultPrompt: Start GitHub Dev Orchestrator. List repositories with a native selection control if available; help me choose an issue.
Work on a GitHub issue using Ponytail full. Show verified context and obtain plan approval before edits.
Draft a new GitHub issue; inspect evidence, invoke Ponytail full, and offer Grill Me if requirements are unclear.
